boundaries.compile: public compile wall latency; IR primed; validation/identity plus CPU/CUDA loading/JIT; Metal metallib only
boundaries.restart: first compile in each new process; excludes interpreter/tensorcx import/device/IR setup; lazy adapter imports included
boundaries.launch: synchronous public launch with resident inputs/artifact, output poisoned before clock; no device-only claim
boundaries.excluded: validation, result cleanup, tensor setup and subprocess startup
boundaries.profile: separate cProfile calls; cumulative times overlap and must not be summed; not benchmark samples
boundaries.host: OS/driver caches are not cleared; shared host, no exclusivity or universal speedup claim

publication.scope: known local identifiers removed; arbitrary text requires review
